sentences.sentence: Hitting candle every months also is very be necessary, but before waxing, should mix hydrosphere besmirch wipe up .

sentences.sentence: To physical science that has denatured reality the world is a material place of molecules and atoms, of solids, liquids and gases, of atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere and biosphere.

sentences.sentence: For example, scientists at Raytheon (RTN) have been working on an exoskeleton to give its user super strength like that of the Hulk.

sentences.sentence: He plans to add regenerative capabilities to the exoskeleton, so that it will require little or no power when moving on level ground.

translations.translation: 有酒窝的, 有凹处的

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 365 单元

hydrosphere
音标：英 /'haɪdrəsfɪə/  美 /'haɪdrosfɪr/
n. 水圈, 水气
例句：Geosphere, hydrosphere and atmosphere are fluids in motion; their main difference is their viscosity.
地圈，水圈和大气是流体；他们的主要差别是他们的黏性。
例句：Hitting candle every months also is very be necessary, but before waxing, should mix hydrosphere besmirch wipe up .
每月打一次蜡也是很有必要的，但是打蜡前要将水气和污渍擦干净。
例句：To physical science that has denatured reality the world is a material place of molecules and atoms, of solids, liquids and gases, of atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere and biosphere. 
对于具有变性的物理学来说世界是由分子、原子，固体、液体、气体，大气圈、水圈、岩石圈和生物圈组成的物质世界；

geyser
音标：英 /'giːzə; 'gaɪ-/  美 /'ɡaɪzɚ/
n. 天然热喷泉

stabilizer
音标：英 /'steɪbɪlaɪzə/  美 /'stebə'laɪzɚ/
n. 稳定器, 安定装置
短语：heat stabilizer — 热稳定剂
短语：light stabilizer — 抗光剂
短语：voltage stabilizer — 电压稳定器，稳压器
短语：fin stabilizer — 减摇鳍装置；防摇鳍，鳍板稳定器
短语：horizontal stabilizer — 水平稳定器
短语：stabilizer bar — 平衡杆
短语：automatic stabilizer — 自动稳定装置

exoskeleton
音标：英 /'eksəʊ,skelɪt(ə)n/  美 /'ɛksoskɛlɪtn/
n. [动] 外骨骼
例句：An advanced onboard micro-computer ensures the exoskeleton moves in concert with the operator.
一种最先进的机载微型电脑确保了外骨骼与操作器一致移动。
例句：For example, scientists at Raytheon (RTN) have been working on an exoskeleton to give its user super strength like that of the Hulk.
举个例子来说吧，雷声公司的研究人员开发一件外骨骼，可以使用户拥有绿巨人一样的强大力量。
例句：He plans to add regenerative capabilities to the exoskeleton, so that it will require little or no power when moving on level ground.
他计划要为外骨骼添加再生能源的能力，使得平地的运行能耗损很少能源或甚至不耗损能源。

dimply
adj. 有酒窝的, 有凹处的
例句：The rough, dimply surfaces of Mentos encourage bubble growth because they efficiently disrupt the polar attractions between water molecules, creating bubble growth sites.
粗糙的有纹路的曼妥斯促使泡泡增长，因为他们有效地中断水分子之间的极吸引力，使泡泡数量变多了。

clamor
音标：英 /'klæmə/  美 /'klæmə/
n. 喧闹
例句：On weekdays, the marmosets steered clear of the roar of traffic, and on Sundays they shunned the clamor of visiting crowds.
工作日的时候，这些狨猴避开嘈杂的交通，星期天的时候它们就会避开喧闹的游客。

mob
音标：英 /mɒb/  美 /mɑb/
n. 暴民 vt成群围住,聚众袭击
例句：They were immediately surrounded by the mob.
他们立刻被那帮暴民包围了。
例句：The leadership had been criticized for giving in to mob rule (= when a mob controls the situation rather than the government or the law ) .
领导层被批评屈服于暴民统治。

enjoyable
音标：英 /ɪn'dʒɒɪəb(ə)l; en-/  美 /ɪn'dʒɔɪəbl/
adj. 有趣的, 愉快的
例句：Games can make learning more enjoyable.
游戏可以寓教于乐。
例句：an enjoyable experience
令人愉快的经历

reluctantly
音标：英 /rɪ'lʌktəntlɪ/  美 /rɪ'lʌktəntli/
adj. 不情愿地；勉强地
例句：The mistress of the house reluctantly installed the two refugees in a spare room.
女主人很不情愿地把两个难民安置在一个空闲的房间里。

overbalance
音标：英 /əʊvə'bæl(ə)ns/  美 /,ovɚ'bæləns/
v. 失去平衡
例句：He overbalanced and fell head first.
他失去了平衡而且头部先着了地。

carbonization
n. 碳化(物)
例句：This entails the destruction of the equipment tested, through carbonization of the insulating material.
这意味着测试设备因绝缘部分的碳化而被破坏。
例句：The speed and development of carbonization not only depend on factors itself, but also on surrounding environment concerned.
碳化速度和发展趋势，不仅取决于混凝土的自身因素，同时与外界环境条件有关。
例句：Modern coal chemical industry has shown a bright future by transferring its basis from coal carbonization to coal gasification.
现代煤化工将其基础从煤的碳化转向煤的气化,从而展现了光明的前景。

marshland
音标：英 /'mɑːʃlənd/  美 /'mɑrʃlænd/
n. 沼泽地
例句：At Honghu Lake, fish spawning has been affected, said Zeng Xiaodong, leader of the Honghu marshland management office.
另据洪湖沼泽管理办公室的曾晓东介绍，洪湖的鱼类的产卵量也受到了很大影响。
例句：Designed by architect Lord Norman Foster –who created the new Wembley Stadium –the airport would be a modern-day feat of British engineering built on reclaimed marshland.
该机场由建筑大师诺曼·福斯特爵士设计建造——他曾设计了新温布利球场——机场将建造在开垦过的沼泽地上，这也是现代英国建筑工程的一大壮举。

viscera
音标：英 /'vɪs(ə)rə/  美 /'vɪsərə/
n. 内脏,内部的东西

lethal
音标：英 /'liːθ(ə)l/  美 /'liθl/
adj. 致命的 n致死因子
短语：lethal weapon — 致命凶器
短语：lethal injection — n. 致命性注射剂；注射处死
短语：lethal dose — [医]致死剂量
短语：lethal concentration — 致死浓度
例句：a lethal dose of heroin
致命剂量的海洛因
例句：a lethal weapon
致命的武器
例句：death by lethal injection
注入致命剂量造成的死亡
例句：a lethal cocktail of drink and pills
一种酒和药的致命混合物

superbly
音标：英 /sju:'pə:bli/  美 /sʊ'pɝbli/
adv. 雄伟地, 壮丽地

shipwright
音标：英 /'ʃɪpraɪt/  美 /'ʃɪp,raɪt/
n. 造船者
例句：What is he that builds stronger than either the mason, the shipwright, or the carpenter?
能比石匠、船匠和木匠建造出更坚固的建筑的人，他是谁？
例句：But she knew that was only because, like Peter the Great in a shipwright's yard, he was studying what he wanted to know.
但是苔丝知道，那只是因为他要学习他想学习的东西，就像彼得大帝到造船厂里去学习一样。

ghostly
音标：英 /'gəʊs(t)lɪ/  美 /'ɡostli/
adj. 可怕的
例句：...Sonia's ghostly laughter.
…索尼娅可怕的怪笑。

thrift
音标：英 /θrɪft/  美 /θrɪft/
n. 节俭
例句：They were rightly praised for their thrift and enterprise.
他们因勤俭节约和开创精神而受到了应得的表扬。

conservatism
音标：英 /kən'sɜːvə,tɪzəm/  美 /kən'sɝvətɪzəm/
n. 保守主义
例句：people’s innate conservatism in matters of language
人们在语言方面天生的守旧

leaky
音标：英 /'liːkɪ/  美 /'liki/
adj. 漏的
例句：The house had a leaky roof.
这房子的屋顶漏雨。
